mushaf_title: Quran (Rasul Ismail-Zade Duzal — ONE translation, THREE scripts)
publication_year: early 20th c. Arabic; reissued Cyrillic & Latin
notes: Duzal's translation printed in Arabic script, then re-issued in Cyrillic and Latin — a script-transition landmark. Also Nazim Zeynalov's SHIITE 'Sviashchennyi Quran: Perevod i Kommentarii' (GloQur #45).
